newsitem.title: USA: Polaroid wins Michigan license contract.
newsitem.headline: Polaroid wins Michigan license contract.

text.p: Polaroid Corp said on Wednesday that it had won a four-year contract from the state of Michigan to produce two million digital driver's licenses annually.
Production of the licenses will begin in the Spring of 1998, Polaroid said in a statement, adding that the contract also includes the manufacture of identification cards.
A spokeswoman for Polaroid declined to disclose a dollar amount for the contract.

"When operational, the new system is expected to reduce the waiting period for a new license or identification card to about one week from the current three to five weeks," the photo equipment company said.
